note: The two sets are nearly identical, sharing the same 21 claims and the same errors: both bind the '#12/2WG.' row to Wiring 151 and the 'AL: 3#4/0, ARMORED CABLE' row to Wiring 150 (the schedule shows those as symbols 10 and 151 respectively), and both leave the row 'AL: 3#4/0, #4G., 2-1/2"C.' under the vague entity 'cable'. The only difference is the attribute label on the Wiring 150 aluminum claim: A says 'conductor material', B says the vaguer 'material'. A is therefore marginally more precise, while both omit the main-panel and interconnect facts (150A/2P main breaker, 200A/2P NFDS NEMA 3R, 120/240V, 4 AWG copper to gnd, L1/L2/N no gnd).
remarks: Both extractions mis-associate schedule symbols: the text layer and image show symbol 10 = 'CU: #12/2WG.' and symbol 151 = 'AL: 3#4/0, ARMORED CABLE', yet both sets label the former 151 and the latter 150. Both also append a symbol number to the quote text that is not part of the quoted description. Neither set captures the NOTES block (main panel 120/240V 150A/2P main breaker with main bonding jumper, 200A/2P NFDS NEMA 3R enclosure) or the interconnect specs (4 AWG copper to gnd; L1, L2 & N, no gnd), which are the main engineering facts on the page.
